CREATE TABLE source (id INT PRIMARY KEY, e ENUM('a\\b', 'c''d', 'é') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4, s SET('x\\y','z') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4, d DECIMAL(7,2), f DOUBLE, dt DATETIME(3), b BIT(5), raw VARBINARY(8))
CREATE TABLE numeric_fields AS SELECT 1 AS a, 12345678901 AS big, CAST(3 AS UNSIGNED) AS u, 1.25 AS deci, 1e2 AS dbl, CAST('1.125' AS DECIMAL(8,3)) AS fixed
SELECT * FROM numeric_fields ORDER BY a,big
CREATE TABLE text_fields AS SELECT _latin1 X'e4' COLLATE latin1_german2_ci AS latin_text, REPEAT('x',512) AS short_text, REPEAT('x',513) AS long_text, NULL AS n, X'0027' AS b
SELECT latin_text, LENGTH(short_text), LENGTH(long_text), n, HEX(b) FROM text_fields
CREATE TABLE dates AS SELECT DATE'2024-01-02' AS d, TIME'03:04:05.123' AS t, TIMESTAMP'2024-01-02 03:04:05.123' AS dt
CREATE TABLE copied AS SELECT id, e, s, d, f, dt, b, raw FROM source
SELECT id, HEX(e), HEX(s), d, f, dt, b, HEX(raw) FROM copied ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE derived AS SELECT id, IFNULL(e,e) AS en, IFNULL(s,s) AS se, d+0 AS de, f+0 AS fl, dt AS stamp, b+0 AS bits FROM source
SELECT id, HEX(en), HEX(se), de, fl, stamp, bits FROM derived ORDER BY id
ALTER TABLE derived ADD COLUMN extra INT DEFAULT 7
SELECT id, HEX(en), HEX(se), extra FROM derived ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE named AS SELECT 'a\b' AS `a``b\c`
CREATE TABLE empty_fields AS SELECT d+0 AS de, f+0 AS fl, IFNULL(e,e) AS en FROM source
CREATE TABLE float_widths AS SELECT 1e2 AS w1, 123456789012345678901234567890e0 AS w2, ABS(1e2) AS w3, 1e2+1 AS w4, 1e2/3 AS w5
